subject: Proposal: Q1 renewal — volume-band pricing & annual true-up
messages:
From: Jake Turner <jake.turner@clearhealth.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Mei Lin <mei.lin@clearhealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal planning — projected +30% usage next year

Hi Rishi,

We’re finishing internal capacity planning for Q1 and we expect our inference volume to grow ~30% year-over-year due to two new product lines. We’re approaching renewal and would like to discuss pricing that reflects higher committed usage but also gives us flexibility for a year-end true-up — we don’t want to overcommit and pay for unused capacity.

Can you share any options you have for multi-band volume pricing (e.g., tiered discounts based on committed monthly tokens) and how you handle mid-term true-ups or credits? Also curious if you can align the contract term to our fiscal year end (Mar 31) so we can co-term with other vendors.

Thanks,
Jake Turner
Lead ML Ops
ClearHealth AI
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jake Turner <jake.turner@clearhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — projected +30% usage next year

Hi Jake — great context, thanks.

High-level options we can run:
- Banding approach: commit to monthly token bands (e.g., 0-500M, 500M-1.5B, 1.5B+) with per-token price steps. Bands are averaged monthly; unused committed tokens can be carried forward to a 30-day credit window or trued-up at year-end at a blended rate.
- Hybrid commit: a base committed spend for SLO-backed capacity + overage at a discounted rate. That helps avoid paying for cold capacity you don’t use.
- Annual committed contract (co-term) with quarterly true-ups: we align to your Mar 31 year-end, prorate the first partial period, then do a single annual reconciliation.

I’m attaching a draft ratecard and a sample true-up worksheet. I’ll loop in finance for discount approval if you’re looking for >15% off list on the high band. Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm what discount ranges we can offer for a 12–24 month commitment at each band? Also flag any required approvals.

Next steps: if the banding model sounds right, I’ll produce a formal proposal with specific band thresholds tied to your expected monthly profile.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Attachments: proposed_ratecard_draft.xlsx, true-up_workbook_sample.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Nov 2026 14:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — quoted discounts and approval path

Rishi — quick internal note on discount bands.

We can reasonably offer the following (for US region, 12-month term, committed monthly bands):
- Band A (0–500M/mo): list price, up to 7% off with manager approval.
- Band B (500M–1.5B/mo): 8–15% off with director approval.
- Band C (1.5B+/mo): 16–25% off requires finance/VP approval and revenue commit.

If the customer signs a 24-month term and prepays 6 months, we can stretch to +3–5% on top of the band discount. True-ups: we recommend annual reconciliation with a 60-day credit window for unused committed tokens (or pro-rata cash refund if preferred by customer).

Karthik — please confirm the language for proration and the sample clause I should include in the redline for legal (I’ll attach suggested text).

Marissa
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jake Turner <jake.turner@clearhealth.ai>, Mei Lin <mei.lin@clearhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: Q1 renewal — volume-band pricing & annual true-up

Hi Jake / Mei — thanks for the patience. Based on your projected +30% growth and our internal bands, attached is our proposal (proposed_ratecard_v3.xlsx) and a redline of commercial terms (CLH_redline_terms_v2.pdf). Highlights: 

- Proposed bands (monthly committed tokens):
  • Band A: 0–500M — $0.00012/token (list), 5% discount for 12m commit
  • Band B: 500M–1.5B — $0.00010/token, 12% discount for 12m commit
  • Band C: 1.5B+ — $0.000085/token, 20% discount for 12m commit (requires revenue commit)
- Annual reconciliation (Mar 31): we’ll true-up actual vs committed and issue a credit for unused committed tokens valid for 90 days. Overage above committed bands billed monthly at the band-specific overage rate (10% higher than band price).
- Co-term: we can align to Mar 31, first period prorated; subsequent years align with fiscal co-term.
- Option: 24-month term + 6 months upfront prepay unlocks an additional 4% discount across bands.

If this looks good, I’ll open a HubSpot amendment and route the redline to Legal. Marissa / Karthik — can you quickly confirm approvals for the Band C 20% level (we’ll need final sign-off from VP Sales/Finance)?

Jake — keen to get your preference on (A) annual credit vs cash refund for unused commit, and (B) whether you want a 12- or 24-month term. If you’re comfortable, I can also include a high-level mutual action plan (dates/sliver milestones) to get this over the line before Jan 15.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Mei Lin <mei.lin@clearhealth.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Turner <jake.turner@clearhealth.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: Q1 renewal — volume-band pricing & annual true-up

Thanks Rishi — reviewed with finance and procurement. We like the band approach and prefer an annual credit (90 days) versus cash refund — less paperwork. Two asks before we can sign: 

1) Can you defer the Band C discount to be contingent on hitting 1.5B tokens/mo for two consecutive months rather than a single month? That reduces our exposure if the growth is lumpy.
2) We need co-term alignment to Mar 31 and a one-time proration for the partial first period (please show numbers in the amendment).

We’re leaning to the 24-month term with 6 months prepay to get the extra 4% provided legal signs off on the redline. If you can get VP approval for the conditional Band C language and update the redline, we can route to signature this week.

-Mei
Head of Platform Operations, ClearHealth AI
Attachment: CH_internal_budget_note.pdf
